function: Radar-aided beam prediction: a CNN predicts the best beam index of a 64-beam codebook from range-angle radar features at the base station (p. 2-4).
system: mmWave MIMO IoV link with FMCW radar at the base station and 64-beam codebook; no RIS; antenna counts and frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: RaFT-BP: federated transfer learning of a CNN (5 conv, 3 FC): pre-trained at edge unit, fine-tuned with frozen layers per node, weights averaged; supervised (p. 3).
data_channel: DeepSense 6G Scenario 9 real-world radar and beam data; 4199 training and 593 test samples, 64 beams; AWGN added for 0, 5, 10 dB (p. 4).
test_conditions: Edge unit pre-trains on 2000 samples, five nodes fine-tune on 300-500 each; 593 test samples; SNR 0, 5, 10 dB; all from DeepSense Scenario 9 (p. 4).
baselines: Learned: radar-aided DL of [6], No-FTL and FTL variants, LeNet, FPN, VGGNet, ResNet, Transformer, LSTM, FLHB [13]; Look Table [7], not described (p. 4-5).
metrics: Top-1 and top-5 beam prediction accuracy, training loss and convergence versus SNR (p. 4-5).
complexity: Analytic time complexity O(.) of convolutional and fully connected layers and FTL-versus-non-TL ratio P_T via FLOPs, no numeric value or runtime (p. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 4: "evaluated by conducting experiments on the DeepSense Scenario 9 [17]"
q2_support: p. 4: "experiments on the DeepSense Scenario 9 [17], where a 64-beam code is considered, the number of training data is 4199, and test data is 593"
q3_support: p. 5: "compared with several baseline approaches, including LeNet, FPN, VGGNet, ResNet, Transformer, LSTM, Look Table [7], and FLHB [13]"
q4_support: p. 4: "the ratio of time complexity PT is expressed as"
q5_support: p. 4: "evaluated by conducting experiments on the DeepSense Scenario 9 [17]"
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 3, not 5: the radar is side information for communication beam selection, with no joint sensing-communication beam or waveform design; FTL averages weights digitally, so not area 7. q1 and q5: DeepSense 6G is a public real-world dataset (ref. [17] title, p. 6). q2 = 0: the edge unit and the five nodes use partitions of one scenario (p. 4); the paper calls them source and target domains (p. 3) but names no different site, scenario or band, so the reviewer should confirm whether the transfer counts. q3 = 0: seven learned baselines are present but the only possible non-learned one, Look Table [7], is never described in the paper, so the reviewer should confirm; if it counts as non-learned, q3 is 1. q4: only formulas (Eqs. 9-13), no numbers or runtime.
